title: End a split test
content_data:
Use this endpoint to stop an ad group level or campaign level split test.
  • In an ad group level split test, once the test is stopped, the status for both ad groups will be inactive.
  • In a campaign level split test, once the test is stopped, campaigns and ad groups will still follow their own schedule, which is independent from the split test schedule. If you stop a campaign level split test before start time, `split_test_status` will be changed to `CANCELED`.
## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/split_test/end/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token{Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | |split_test_group_id {Required} | string | Split test group ID. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/v1.3/split_test/end/' \ --header 'Access-Token: xxx' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data-raw '{ "advertiser_id": "xxx", "split_test_group_id": "xx" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object| Returned data. | |request_id|string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "xx", "data": {} } (/code) ```
